title: Framed Shadow Portrait
description: A man with short dark hair and a serious expression stares directly forward from within a thin, illuminated rectangular frame. He holds a small dark object between his fingers near the right side of his face, set against a completely black background.
prompt: A serious man with short dark hair stares intensely at the viewer from inside a thin glowing rectangular frame centered in a vast black void. He is wearing a dark collared shirt and holds a small dark object up near the right side of his face with his fingers. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with strong contrast, moody and mysterious atmosphere, highly detailed realistic digital painting.
